title: Universal EOS-Radius Inverse Mappings Govern Precision-Dependent Inference of the Neutron Star Equation of State
summary: Bayesian inference of the neutron star (NS) equation of state (EOS) generally assumes that improved observations primarily reduce posterior uncertainties while leaving inferred EOS parameters unchanged. Using mock measurements of the radius of a canonical $1.4\,M_\odot$ NS with identical central values but varying observational precisions, we show that the inferred posterior means of EOS parameters can shift systematically as the measurement uncertainty changes.
